title: Man with Parasitic Worm
description: A Victorian gentleman in a floral-embroidered black coat and top hat sits holding a large, grotesque, multi-legged larval creature across his lap. The pale blueish-purple creature has prominent eyes, sharp mandibles, and is covered in golden floral growths while swarms of flies and insects buzz around both figures.
prompt: A somber Victorian man wearing an ornate black coat with golden floral embroidery and a tall black top hat sits and holds a giant grotesque larval creature on his lap. The pale blueish segmented worm has multiple legs, large eyes, sharp mandibles, and is covered in golden floral patterns. Swarms of flies and insects fly around them both. Dramatic golden light from above, dark patterned blue curtains in the background, surreal and disturbing atmosphere, highly detailed oil painting style.
